concepts.name: GenerativeAI
concepts.description: AI systems that produce new content (text, images, code) by reframing tasks as extremely open-ended prediction.

concepts.name: StatisticalAI
concepts.description: Previous generation of AI focused on analysis and prediction for specific tasks like classification or translation, but did not generate truly new content.

concepts.name: TransformerArchitecture
concepts.description: Model architecture introduced in 2017 ('Attention Is All You Need') that handles long sequences and vast training data, forming the foundation of modern Generative AI.

concepts.name: SelfAttention
concepts.description: A mechanism within Transformers that allows the model to directly access context over long sequences, giving it the 'long-term memory' it previously lacked.

concepts.name: FineTuning
concepts.description: A permanent change to the core model itself to make it better at a specific task or domain, for example, using a technique like LoRA.

concepts.name: Prompting
concepts.description: Giving the general model a temporary instruction (input) to receive an output, without altering the underlying core of the model.

concepts.name: ModelAlignment
concepts.description: The process of teaching a powerful statistical tool to use its knowledge responsibly and safely, aligning its behavior with human values because it lacks an innate moral compass.

concepts.name: UserRole
concepts.description: A category describing an individual's level of engagement, knowledge, and required skill set concerning AI technology, based on the Automotive Analogy.

concepts.name: AutomotiveAnalogy
concepts.description: An analogy used to explain how artificial intelligence spans an extremely wide variety of fields, careers, and impacts on everyday life.

relations.name: buildsUpon
relations.description: Indicates that one concept or technology is an evolution or extension of another.

relations.name: isMechanismOf
relations.description: Indicates a core component or enabling technology.

relations.name: contains
relations.description: Indicates an architectural component of a model.

relations.name: modifiesPermanently
relations.description: Indicates a permanent change to the model's core structure.

values.requiredKnowledge: Must understand that not all content is human-written; watch for trustworthiness.
Learns to operate the technology effectively and knows the 'rules of the road' (how to use it).
Can investigate issues (check engine light) or make minor modifications (e.g., changing the hubcaps).
Paid to repair AI systems for a living, able to make bigger repairs or modifications.
Designs and builds the core AI systems (the people who make the cars).

values.description: A powerful, capable system (like a fast engine) that is not safe or useful until safety features are added.
The features that take raw power and ensure the system operates responsibly and safely once in the world.
